title: Research Graph v0.04 semantic-identity registry
description: Executable contract for the Knowledge/Claim/Dependency graph. This file is normative: validate_research_graph.py enforces everything declared here. Graph nodes and relations are views over the Research Database (data/research_db); they never replace it.

node_types.definition: A formally introduced object, symbol, term, model, operator, quantity, or rule.
node_types.claim: A statement capable of carrying an epistemic status. C = (S, sigma); sigma defaults to unknown.
node_types.argument: An inferential transition A: (C_i1..C_ik) -> C_m. Not every derivation is a proof; proof_status stays unknown by default.
node_types.experiment: E = (H, M, P, R, I). Experiments support claims; the vocabulary has no 'proves' relation.
node_types.failure: A first-class record of attempt -> failure -> diagnosis -> repair. Research value, not an embarrassment.

depends_on.meaning: The source cannot be stated or evaluated without the target.

contradicts.meaning: The source is evidence against the target claim.

supersedes.meaning: The source replaces the target as the current best version. Requires symmetric superseded_by handling on the target node.

refines.meaning: The source is a sharper, more precise version of the target without fully replacing it.

tests.meaning: The experiment was designed to probe the claim.

falsifies.meaning: The source supplies a counterexample or refutation of the target claim.

repairs.meaning: The failure diagnosis led to a corrected version of the target.

defines.meaning: The source definition introduces objects used by the target.

uses.meaning: The source invokes objects introduced by the target definition.

status_vocabularies.epistemic_status: Reuses the Research Database registry in schemas/research_record.schema.json (16 values). Default: unknown.

id_rules.purpose: Deterministic semantic IDs make re-extraction idempotent: the same normalized scientific object found across many conversations collapses into one node. source_record_ids remain an independently merged provenance set and never change identity.

requires: review.evidence_record_ids is non-empty and all resolve to Research DB records
candidate_to_reviewed.note: No extractor, heuristic, or LLM may promote a node or relation. Review is a human-with-evidence act.

status_promotion.requires: epistemic_status stronger than unknown requires review.evidence_record_ids citing explicit verified evidence (machine-checked proof artifacts, receipts, test results)

requires: a supersedes relation from the replacing node to the replaced node
the replaced node's lifecycle becomes superseded and its superseded_by field points at the replacing node

statement_policy.rule: statement text must be a verbatim excerpt from the cited source records, or a normalized paraphrase explicitly marked statement_basis=normalized with normalization notes in review.notes.

storage_layout.note: All files are gitignored views/index structures over the Research DB, not a third archive.
